title: JUMPCORE
description: Jumpcore is a first-person precision platformer that combines momentum-based movement and collectathon exploration across liminal spaces. Descend through the hollow remains of creation using jumps, slides and dashes to recover what was lost in the silence.

title: DOOM II Maps
description: Compilation of some of my best DOOM maps. I had created over 70 maps. Adquired skills in mapping design, combat and puzzle design, scripting, and environment art.

title: Wandering Below
description: Wandering Below is a 2D platformer game with a heavy emphasis on exploration. The game consist of one big level with multiple paths to take, where the player must find a certain number of gems to unlock the exit.
